disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置中的硬编码密钥、敏感路径读取与云凭据枚举模式：插件仅读取自身数据目录内的记忆库、文档索引与运行时记忆文件，未发现读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 密钥或云配置的代码。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration for hardcoded secrets, sensitive path reads, and cloud credential enumeration patterns: the plugin only reads the memory store, document index, and runtime memory files inside its own data directory; no code was found that reads host credential files, SSH keys, or cloud configuration.

checked_items.zh: 外部记忆服务的 API Key 由用户配置并存入插件设置，仅在调用对应服务时使用（经环境变量或 HTTP 头传递），未发现向非对应端点外发这些密钥的路径。
checked_items.en: The API Key for the external memory service is configured by the user and stored in plugin settings, and is only used when calling the corresponding service (passed via environment variable or HTTP header); no path was found that exfiltrates these keys to non-corresponding endpoints.

evidence.zh: 核查了凭据读取面：插件读取的文件均在其自身数据目录（记忆库、文档、备份包），未读取宿主凭据文件；API Key 仅用于用户配置的记忆服务调用，未发现凭据读取后外发的链路。
evidence.en: Reviewed the credential read surface: the files read by the plugin are all within its own data directory (memory store, documents, backup packages), and it does not read host credential files; API Keys are only used for the user-configured memory service calls, and no chain was found where credentials are read then exfiltrated.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部 12 个注册工具的描述与参数定义：均为记忆/文档读写与状态查询的功能说明，无指令覆写、权限提升、诱导安装或诱导泄露凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the descriptions and parameter definitions of all 12 registered tools: they are all functional descriptions for memory/document read-write and status queries, with no wording for instruction override, privilege escalation, induced installation, or induced credential leakage.

checked_items.zh: 检查了注入系统提示的代码：仅注入一段路由引导文本（何时使用记忆工具）与运行时记忆内容（用户自己的记忆文件），未发现伪装系统消息、隐藏指令或远程指令加载。
checked_items.en: Checked the code that injects system prompts: it only injects a routing guidance text (when to use memory tools) and runtime memory content (the user's own memory files); no disguised system messages, hidden instructions, or remote instruction loading were found.

checked_items.zh: 文档与说明文本中未发现提示词注入类措辞。
checked_items.en: No prompt injection style wording was found in documentation and descriptive text.

evidence.zh: 工具注册代码（src/tools.ts）中的全部工具描述与系统提示注入点（src/guidance.ts）均为记忆功能说明与路由引导，无注入措辞。
evidence.en: All tool descriptions and system prompt injection points in the tool registration code (src/tools.ts) and (src/guidance.ts) are memory function descriptions and routing guidance, with no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与界面文本中未发现诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；版本更新功能由用户在界面手动点击触发。
evidence.en: No wording was found in tool descriptions and UI text that induces the model to perform installations, rewrite configuration, or loosen permissions; the version update function is triggered by the user manually clicking in the UI.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部 yml 配置（含挂载配置）中的可执行 JS 标量：未命中，挂载配置仅声明自身服务参数。
checked_items.en: Scanned all yml configuration files (including patch config) for executable JS scalars: no matches; the patch config only declares its own service parameters.

checked_items.zh: 预扫标记的子进程调用点共 5 处（规则族 X03 / DG-R3-55）：3 个构建验证脚本仅在开发者本地构建时调用构建工具；src/process.ts 是运行式子进程封装（无 shell、输出有界、可取消），用于调用本地 mnemon 命令行工具；src/providers/byterover.ts 用同一封装调用本地 brv 工具。命令与参数均为代码固定向量，未见远程载荷、动态解码或 base64 解码即执行。
checked_items.en: Pre-scanned subprocess invocation points: 5 total (rule family X03 / DG-R3-55): 3 build verification scripts only invoke build tools during developer local build; src/process.ts is a runtime subprocess wrapper (no shell, bounded output, cancellable) used to invoke the local mnemon CLI tool; src/providers/byterover.ts uses the same wrapper to invoke the local brv tool. Commands and arguments are fixed vectors in code; no remote payloads, dynamic decoding, or decode-then-execute of base64 were seen.

checked_items.zh: 客户端侧（规则族 X05 / DG-R3-57）：键盘监听仅用于对话框 Esc/Tab 焦点管理，剪贴板写入仅复制记忆 ID 的按钮，均为常规 UI 交互，未发现键盘记录或剪贴板窃取；预扫的长行/高熵信号（规则族 X08 / DG-R3-60）为大型 JSX 渲染表达式与内嵌品牌图标 base64 图片，非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Client side (rule family X05 / DG-R3-57): keyboard listening is only used for dialog Esc/Tab focus management, clipboard writes are only for the button that copies the memory ID; these are normal UI interactions, with no keylogging or clipboard theft found; the pre-scanned long-line/high-entropy signals (rule family X08 / DG-R3-60) are large JSX render expressions and embedded base64 brand icons, not obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 未发现 eval、new Function 或动态解码执行模式；客户端声明 dsh.client，其加载面按上述客户端检查结果判定为常规 UI。
checked_items.en: No eval, new Function, or dynamic decode-then-execute patterns were found; the client declares dsh.client, and its loading surface is judged as normal UI based on the client checks above.

evidence.zh: 全部 yml 文件（含挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 与仓库内其他 yaml）均未含可执行 JS 标量，不存在配置即执行面。
evidence.en: All yml files (including the patch config cordis.patch.yml and other yamls in the repo) contain no executable JS scalars; there is no configuration-as-code execution surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具的调用（未命中 cordis_define / cordis_run 等引用）。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools were found (no matches for cordis_define / cordis_run references, etc.).

evidence.zh: package.json 无 install/prepare 等安装钩子；仓库自带 CI 工作流（规则族 X07 / DG-R3-59，共 6 个）为常规工程流程（测试、发布、Issue/PR 管理），不随插件包发布、不进入插件运行面；provider-lab 下的 docker 文件（规则族 C05 / DG-R4-53）为本地实验环境，其中镜像构建会执行 supermemory 官方安装脚本，但该目录不随 npm 包发布。
evidence.en: package.json has no install/prepare or other install hooks; the repo's own CI workflows (rule family X07 / DG-R3-59, 6 total) are normal engineering processes (testing, release, Issue/PR management) and are not shipped with the plugin package nor part of the plugin runtime surface; the docker files under provider-lab (rule family C05 / DG-R4-53) are a local experiment environment, where the image build executes the official supermemory install script, but that directory is not shipped with the npm package.

evidence.zh: 客户端模块声明注入已确认（package.json 的 dsh.client 段），专项检查未发现键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或调用宿主凭据接口的行为。
evidence.en: Client module declaration injection is confirmed (the dsh.client section of package.json); targeted checks found no keylogging, clipboard theft, or calls to host credential interfaces.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部网络外联点：记忆提供方 HTTP 调用（端点由用户配置，默认值指向各提供方官方 API：api.honcho.dev、api.mem0.ai、api.hindsight.vectorize.io、api.retaindb.com、api.supermemory.ai 及本地 OpenViking）；版本检查（registry.npmjs.org、api.github.com）；未发现裸 IP、隧道、粘贴板服务或编码外发链。
checked_items.en: Checked all network outbound points: memory provider HTTP calls (endpoints configured by the user, defaults point to each provider's official API: api.honcho.dev, api.mem0.ai, api.hindsight.vectorize.io, api.retaindb.com, api.supermemory.ai, and local OpenViking); version check (registry.npmjs.org, api.github.com); no raw IPs, tunnels, paste services, or encoded exfiltration chains were found.

checked_items.zh: 开发实验室的 docker-compose 健康检查与镜像内 curl（规则族 C05 / DG-R4-53）仅探测本地容器端口或安装官方工具，不随插件发布。
checked_items.en: The dev lab's docker-compose health checks and in-image curl (rule family C05 / DG-R4-53) only probe local container ports or install official tools, and are not shipped with the plugin.

evidence.zh: 核查外联通道：所有网络请求都指向用户配置的记忆服务端点或官方版本检查地址，未发现读取凭据后向外发送的链路。
evidence.en: Reviewed outbound channels: all network requests point to user-configured memory service endpoints or official version check addresses; no chain was found that reads credentials and then sends them outward.

checked_items.zh: 核查依赖清单：运行依赖为常规 npm 包（fflate、markdown-to-jsx、schemastery），dsh 宿主相关包为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列；未见与 dsh 生态撞名的可疑包。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the dependency list: runtime dependencies are standard npm packages (fflate, markdown-to-jsx, schemastery), and dsh host related packages are the official @deepseek-ai series; no suspicious packages that collide with the dsh ecosystem were found.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子与版本引用：无 install 类钩子；更新机制中对外部 mnemon 命令行工具使用 @latest 浮动引用（go install），插件自身更新走 npm 语义化版本；属外部工具更新通道而非插件自身依赖面。
checked_items.en: Install hooks and version references: no install-type hooks; the update mechanism uses a @latest floating reference for the external mnemon CLI tool (go install), while the plugin itself updates via npm semantic versioning; this is an external tool update channel, not the plugin's own dependency surface.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入自身服务配置，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，未改写注入/拦截配置，未含环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts its own service configuration, does not touch security lines like sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not rewrite injection/interception config, and contains no syntax that downgrades environment variable permissions.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件的高优先级监听截断审批链的代码；作者标识 omdsh-dev，无同形异义或撞名仿冒迹象。
checked_items.en: No high-priority listeners on security events that truncate the approval chain were found; the author identifier is omdsh-dev, with no homoglyph or name-collision impersonation indicators.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅声明自身服务参数，未覆盖或禁用任何安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch config only declares its own service parameters and does not override or disable any security configuration lines.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批/预执行安全事件的高优先级监听，无截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on approval/pre-execution security events were found, and no code that truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线，无法做升级自动激活比对。
evidence.en: First-time audit, no previous version baseline, so no upgrade auto-activation comparison could be performed.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，无给安全服务追加必需服务致其挂起的写法。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception config, and contains no syntax that appends required services to security services to hang them.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，无运行观测数据（未做动态验证）。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox is not enabled and there is no runtime observation data (dynamic verification not performed).

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口；本机无认证 RPC 属 dsh 宿主固有风险，插件自身通过回环/受信主机分级授权其 RPC 通道（默认写通道仅回环可访问）。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; the unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the dsh host, and the plugin itself authorizes its RPC channel through loopback/trusted-host tiering (the default write channel is only accessible via loopback).

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务或监听端口；该场景属宿主固有风险，且本插件对 RPC 通道设置了回环/受信主机授权，故不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports; this scenario is an inherent host risk, and the plugin has set loopback/trusted-host authorization for its RPC channel, so it is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件标识与任务卡一致，package.json 含 dsh 声明（挂载配置与客户端注入），作者无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: The plugin identifier matches the task card, package.json contains the dsh declaration (patch config and client injection), and the author shows no impersonation indicators.

summary.zh: 静态扫描：预扫 22 条命中全部逐条复核，均为常规工程基础设施、自述功能所需的本地命令行编排或正常 UI 交互，未发现需落入发现项的恶意模式。
summary.en: Static scan: all 22 pre-scanned hits were individually reviewed and are conventional engineering infrastructure, local CLI orchestration needed for the self-described functionality, or normal UI interactions; no malicious patterns requiring a finding were found.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取后外发的链路。
summary.en: Behavior surface analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no chain that reads credential files and then exfiltrates them.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：工具描述与系统提示注入均无注入措辞，能力面与自述业务自洽。
summary.en: AI metadata review: tool descriptions and system prompt injections contain no injection wording, and the capability surface is consistent with the self-described business.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无运行观测数据）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no runtime observation data).

undeclared_observed.zh: 网络请求：调用用户配置的记忆提供方 HTTP 端点，并向 npm registry 与 GitHub API 发起版本检查。
undeclared_observed.en: Network requests: calls the user-configured memory provider HTTP endpoints, and performs version checks against the npm registry and GitHub API.

undeclared_observed.zh: 子进程执行：调用本地 mnemon / brv 命令行工具，并在用户触发更新时执行 pnpm / brew / go 命令。
undeclared_observed.en: Subprocess execution: invokes the local mnemon / brv CLI tools, and executes pnpm / brew / go commands when the user triggers an update.

undeclared_observed.zh: 文件读写：读写自身数据目录（记忆库、项目文档、运行时记忆、备份包）。
undeclared_observed.en: File read/write: reads and writes its own data directory (memory store, project documents, runtime memory, backup packages).

undeclared_observed.zh: 模型可见：注册 12 个工具与系统提示段，记忆内容会进入模型上下文。
undeclared_observed.en: Model visible: registers 12 tools and a system prompt section; memory content enters the model context.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 L4 观测数据）。插件 package.json 的 dsh 段仅声明挂载配置与客户端注入，未提供正式能力声明，报告中的能力面（联网、子进程、文件读写、模型可见）按代码实测推断。provider-lab 与 .github 目录未随 npm 包发布，仅作为仓库内开发基础设施审阅。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no L4 observation data). The dsh section in the plugin's package.json only declares the patch config and client injection, with no formal capability declaration; the capability surface in this report (network, subprocess, file read/write, model visibility) is inferred from code inspection. The provider-lab and .github directories are not shipped with the npm package and were reviewed only as development infrastructure within the repo.
